title: The Vegetarian and the Hospital Escape

scenes.title: Ode to Meat and the Hospital Breakfast
scenes.summary: Max praises juicy marbled beef and lamb before a vegetarian guest arrives at Claude Monet, while Chef Barinov suffers through a meatless hospital breakfast.

scenes.title: An Order for the Vegetarian
scenes.summary: Nastya asks Lyova to prepare a meatless dish for her vegetarian guest, and when Lyova refuses, she persuades Max to make vegetable rolls instead.

scenes.title: Contraband Pizza in the Ward
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov tries to sneak a delivery pizza into his hospital ward, only for the staff to confiscate it at the door before his fellow patients beg for slices.

scenes.title: Meat in the Vegetarian Rolls
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya secretly slip meat into Max's vegetarian rolls while he steps away, and Max decides not to panic because the guest will never notice.

scenes.title: The Guest's Delight and Nagiyev's Task
scenes.summary: Nastya tells Max that the vegetarian guest loved the rolls, while Nagiyev orders Senya and Fedya to scare off a paparazzo spying on him and Kristina.

scenes.title: Hunting the Paparazzo
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya sneak out to intimidate the man sitting in a parked car outside Claude Monet, but Fedya accidentally knocks him unconscious.

scenes.title: Hostage in the Trunk
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya realize the photographer is still alive, inspect his camera photos, and lock him inside the car while they figure out what to do next.

scenes.title: Phone Calls from the Hospital
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov calls Lyova and Fedya begging them to smuggle a steak into the hospital, but Vika intercepts Lyova and Fedya is too busy to help.

scenes.title: Reporting to Nagiyev About the Journalist
scenes.summary: While Chef Barinov climbs out his first-floor hospital window, Senya and Fedya boast to Nagiyev that they captured the journalist and tied him up.

scenes.title: A Second Helping of Rolls
scenes.summary: Nagiyev goes out with Senya and Fedya to deal with the captive, while the vegetarian guest returns to Claude Monet and orders the exact same rolls from Max.

scenes.title: The Chef Without Documents
scenes.summary: Max hands Nastya a purely vegetarian batch of rolls while keeping the meat ones for himself, and police officers stop Chef Barinov on the street in his hospital robe.

scenes.title: Panic by the Car and a Call from the Police
scenes.summary: Nagiyev panics when the bound photographer recognizes him outside the restaurant, while detained Chef Barinov convinces the police to call Nagiyev to vouch for him.

scenes.title: A Double Misunderstanding with the Police
scenes.summary: When the police call Nagiyev to ask about detaining a man, Nagiyev thinks they caught him kidnapping the paparazzo and hangs up in terror before Vika calls him.

scenes.title: Hiding in the Fridge and Riding with the Police
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya haul the bound captive into the restaurant walk-in fridge, while Chef Barinov persuades the police officers to drive him to Claude Monet.

scenes.title: Return of the Runaway
scenes.summary: Nastya tells Max that the vegetarian guest disliked the meatless rolls and wants them made like the morning batch, just as the police bring Chef Barinov into the restaurant.

scenes.title: Hospital Punishment and the Meat Secret
scenes.summary: Back in the hospital ward, the nurse scolds Barinov for climbing out the window while Vika discovers him wolfing down smuggled meat under his blanket.

scenes.title: Confessing to Nastya and the Captive in the Fridge
scenes.summary: Max confesses to a horrified Nastya that the morning rolls contained meat, while Kristina arrives at Claude Monet and calls the man sitting inside the walk-in fridge.

scenes.title: Kristina's Private Detective
scenes.summary: Kristina opens the walk-in cooler and reveals that the bound man is actually the private detective she hired to spy on Nagiyev, turning the tables on her husband.

scenes.title: The Former Vegetarian and Changing for Love
scenes.summary: The vegetarian guest returns to Claude Monet to order a juicy steak after tasting meat again, while Kostya and Nastya secretly compromise their habits for each other.
